root.label: Dallas keeps grant-funded Flock cameras operating

events.label: Dallas keeps grant-funded Flock cameras operating

slots.name: camera count
slots.sentence: Dallas will keep more than 300 Flock Safety cameras originally slated for removal after the surveillance company paused certain agencies’ payments for the devices for 90 days

slots.name: agreement status
slots.sentence: Flock Safety CEO Garrett Langley met with Dallas Police Wednesday night, after which the department publicly announced the deal which will keep the grant-funded cameras operating.
